Where can I find your full shipping policy?
Hi John, I'm Violet! Thanks for chatting with SPANX! 🌟 Happy to help with shipping info.
Here's a quick rundown of our US shipping options:
Standard: 5-9 business days total. $7 for orders under $75, free for orders $75+, and always free for Icon Rewards Members.
Basic: 3-4 business days total. $15.
Expedited: 1-2 business days total. $25.
Overnight: 1 business day total. $30.
Orders are processed Monday-Friday (excluding holidays), and orders placed after 12 PM EST begin processing the next business day. The full timeline includes both processing and transit time.
A couple of things to note:
APO/FPO/DPO addresses and US Territories may take up to 30 days via Standard shipping.
Basic, Expedited, and Overnight aren't available for Alaska, Hawaii, PO boxes, APO/FPO/DPO addresses, or US territories.
